relevance_note: Registry cohort of 84 LAD patients undergoing allo-HSCT; Tables 5 ('Deceased patients') and 6 ('Second allo-HSCT') give per-patient columns with LAD type, sex and transplant outcomes, e.g. '69 patients (82%) were identified as LAD-I'.
method_note: EBMT registry retrospective study (84 LAD patients: 69 LAD-I, 11 LAD-III, 4 unclassified). Only Tables 5 and 6 give individual-level data; both are rotated tables with patients as columns, and a Python script in the scratch directory sliced the Markdown cells into spans; I checked its output against the tables. Table 5 (Deceased patients, 13 columns): the first column header merges the row label and the first patient's value (e.g. 'Sex M'), so 'Table 5 column 1' is that merged first cell; columns are counted from the left as data columns. In-scope (LAD row = 'I'): columns 1,2,3,6,7,8,9,11,12,13. Out of scope: columns 4 and 10 (LAD III) and column 5 (LAD type cell empty). Table 6 (Second allo-HSCT, 15 patient columns after two label columns both headed 'LFU since 1st allo- HSCT, mo'; rows run bottom-to-top: Sex, LAD type, Age at HSCT, a First allo-HSCT block, then a Second allo-HSCT block, then LFU). In the conversion the LAD type of data columns 1, 2 and 15 appears merged into the 'Age at HSCT, mo' row ('I 19', 'III 25', 'III 44'); I read column 1 as LAD-I from 'I 19' (uncertain; consistent with the text that PGF occurred in 2 LAD-I and 1 LAD-III patients, of whom two received a second transplant). In-scope Table 6 columns: 1,3,4,5,6,8,9,10,11,12,13; out of scope: 2, 14, 15 (LAD III) and 7 ('Other'). Same person in both tables: Table 6 column 8 matches Table 5 column 2 on every shared cell (Dead; LAD I; M; age 23; first donor MUD, BM 10/10, Bu 1 Cy, ATG, CSA 1 corticosteroids; engraftment Yes, 149; aGVHD grade I; GF SGF, 12; Table 5 '2nd allo-HSCT' = 'SGF, 14' and Table 6 second GF 'SGF, 14'), and Table 5 lists all deceased patients; I recorded one person labelled 'Table 5 column 2' and added the Table 6 column 8 second-transplant data to that row. Likewise Table 6 column 2 matches Table 5 column 4 (both LAD III, out of scope). The conversion garbles symbols ('1' for '+', ',' for '<', '$' for >=); values are copied as printed and not corrected, and numeric timings (e.g. 'SGF, 12', 'Infection, 126') are kept only as detail text. The unlabeled 'Age, mo' row of Table 5 and 'Age at HSCT, mo' of Table 6 are ages at transplant, not onset, diagnosis or last evaluation, so those fields are 'not reported'. Phenotypic rows record transplant outcomes stated per column: aGVHD grade I-IV as observed and 'No' as excluded; grade '0'/'Grade 0' and '-' cells are left unrecorded because the paper does not define those symbols; GF (PGF/SGF observed, 'No' excluded); infection or septic shock as cause of death. Septic shock (Table 5 column 6) is the only checklist item marked (sepsis observed); all other checklist items are not reported. Engraftment, CMV and chimerism details are not recorded as features. No ITGB2 variant is printed or attributed to any patient (diagnosis 'based on CD11/CD18 expression and/or genetic confirmation'), so the variants table is empty. clinical_diagnosis_basis is filled from that cohort-wide methods sentence. n_patients_reported is the stated LAD-I count (69); the number with an ITGB2 variant is not stated. No contradictions found.
